'''Sal-Deron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Third Galactic War|third galactic conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She worked with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and was one of their best operatives.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is Master Sal-Deron. She's been instrumental in tracking down former Jedi and identifying potential additions to the Order.|Master [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Secrets" />}}
[[File:SalDeron.png|thumb|190px|left|Master Sal-Deron early during the Third Galactic War]]
Master Sal-Deron was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that was well-versed in reconnaissance and intelligence, skills generally lacked by most members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. For this reason, she was recruited by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to assist in their operations. Though many [[Agent/Legends|agents]] were skeptical of Sal-Deron's ability to perform sensitive operations, she soon proved her worth<ref name="Codex" /> and was considered by [[Jonas Balkar]] to be "one of the best covert operators he had ever known."<ref name="TOR:OM" /> Sal-Deron developed a reputation of achieving her goals even without the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], gaining her the respect of friends and foes alike.<ref name="Codex" />

When the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] the rest of [[the galaxy]], the information service's agents helped her go underground and she began to work on tracking down former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and identifying promising recruits for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Codex" /> a job she also excelled at. Sal-Deron continued this task after the Eternal Empire was [[War against Zakuul|toppled]].<ref name="Secrets" />

[[File:Sal-Deron_and_holocron.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Master Sal-Deron seizes Darth Nul's holocron]]
When [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] returned from their mission to the old [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], where they investigated the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]], Sal-Deron was one of the Jedi chosen by Master [[Gnost-Dural]] to discuss the next moves in rebuilding the Jedi after the war against Zakuul. Gnost-Dural chose to invite her, along with [[Tau Idair]] and [[Vinyor Tesh]], to the gathering because Gnost-Dural believed them to be the Order's most important representatives.<ref name="Secrets" />

During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] of the [[Third Galactic War]], Master Sal-Deron accompanied [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]] on [[Odessen]] to seize [[Darth Nul's holocron]] from the [[Alliance Commander]]. However, when she attempted to unlock it, the relic violently threw her against a wall. Recovering, she quickly accused the Commander of tampering with it, as they were the only one who had access to it. Admiral [[Barus Rava]] moved to support her, noting the convenience that [[Shae Vizla]] [[Malgus's escape|liberated]] Malgus while the Commander protected the object he coveted, suggesting the Commander was trying to conceal the holocron's secrets. Chancellor Rans shut them down, and declared that until Malgus was recaptured or they had cleared the Commander of any wrongdoing, the Alliance base was officially under Republic lockdown. As they left the room, Sal-Deron took the holocron with her, but Idair would later steal it back so she and the Commander could escape and rendezvous with [[Darth Jadus]].<ref name="TOR:TME" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
If the player is an Imperial who has decided to side with the Republic they will meet Jonas Balkar and Sal-Deron on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During that meeting Master Sal-Deron will ask the player to help protect the remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that she would soon be summoning to return to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR:OM" />

Republic players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]] can attempt to flirt with her after ''Secrets of the Enclave'', but she only responds dismissively.<ref name="Secrets" />
